sections.Profile:
"Comics" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in February 1968. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, a center up-post, and spinning posts.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Comics
